recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中央有一團彼此緊密鑲嵌（nuclear molding）的大型細胞，核淡染、染色質細緻、細胞質稀少，與周圍大量染色質塊狀的小型 CLL 淋巴球明顯不同；插圖 cytokeratin 陽性，證實是轉移癌（Merkel cell carcinoma）而非 Richter 轉化。
features: Cohesive cluster of large cells with nuclear molding and poorly defined cell borders
Pale, finely granular (salt-and-pepper) chromatin with inconspicuous nucleoli and scant cytoplasm
Interspersed dark, crushed/degenerating nuclei within the cluster
Background of numerous small mature lymphocytes with clumped chromatin (CLL)
Inset: cytokeratin immunostain positive in a nest of tumor cells, negative in surrounding lymphoid cells
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a background of numerous small mature lymphocytes with condensed chromatin, consistent with chronic lymphocytic leukemia. A cohesive cluster of larger cells with nuclear molding, pale finely granular chromatin and scant cytoplasm is present, with interspersed crushed nuclei. The inset immunostain shows a cytokeratin-positive nest of tumor cells separate from the lymphoid infiltrate. Findings are consistent with metastatic neuroendocrine carcinoma (Merkel cell carcinoma) involving a marrow with CLL, mimicking Richter transformation; CK20 (dot-like), neuroendocrine markers and Merkel cell polyomavirus staining support the diagnosis.

ddx.vs: Large lymphoma cells are discohesive, lack nuclear molding and are CD20-positive and cytokeratin-negative.
Small cell carcinoma looks the same but is typically TTF-1-positive and CK20-negative, whereas Merkel cell carcinoma is CK20-positive with a dot-like pattern and TTF-1-negative.
Prolymphocytes are single, discohesive cells with a central prominent nucleolus and B-cell immunophenotype.

ddx.dx: Neuroblastoma or other small round blue cell tumor
ddx.vs: Neuroblastoma occurs in children, forms rosettes with neuropil and is cytokeratin-negative.
